info.title: E-Commerce Order & Promotion API
info.description: E-commerce orders, carts, products and promotions. Money is represented as integer minor units. Register or log in to obtain a Sanctum token, then send Authorization: Bearer <token>. Administrative permissions are provisioned through local Artisan commands; there is no public role assignment endpoint.

servers.description: Same origin as the documentation; uses the configured local host and APP_PORT.

post.description: Bodyless checkout. Optional Idempotency-Key scopes replays to this customer. A fresh checkout returns 201; a valid replay returns the existing order with 200. Replay is checked before empty-cart eligibility. Without a key there is no replay guarantee.

product_id.description: Active product ID; strict positive JSON integer.

quantity.description: Strict positive JSON integer bounded by current stock. Adding to an existing line increments its quantity; PATCH replaces it.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code from the centralized API exception handler.
Trimmed and uppercased. One initial alphanumeric character followed by alphanumerics, underscores or hyphens; maximum 64 characters.

enum: The promotion code was not found.
The promotion has not started yet.
The cart subtotal does not meet the promotion minimum.
The promotion global usage limit has been reached.
The promotion customer usage limit has been reached.
The cart must contain at least one item.
All cart items must be currently purchasable to apply a promotion.

password.description: At most 72 UTF-8 bytes, no null bytes. The existing account password.

items.description: Item snapshots are included in detail, checkout and cancellation responses; omitted from order history.

name.description: Trimmed nonempty string; null bytes are rejected.

sku.description: Trimmed nonempty string; null bytes are rejected. Must be unique.

description.description: Nullable text; explicit null clears the description. Null bytes are rejected.

price_minor.description: Nonnegative strict JSON integer in minor units (12900 = 129.00).

stock_quantity.description: Initial absolute inventory. Strict JSON integer. stock_adjustment must be absent.

percentage_basis_points.description: Percentage in basis points: 1000 means 10 percent. Null for fixed promotions.

code.description: Trimmed and uppercased. One initial alphanumeric character followed by alphanumerics, underscores or hyphens; maximum 64 characters.

value.description: Strict JSON integer. percentage: 1..10000 basis points (1000 = 10%); fixed: positive minor units up to PHP_INT_MAX. PATCH checks the retained type/value too.

minimum_cart_amount_minor.description: Strict JSON integer; numeric strings and floating-point values are rejected.

maximum_discount_minor.description: Positive strict JSON integer or null. Null removes the cap/limit; omission preserves it on PATCH. Usage limits cannot be reduced below consumed usage.

global_usage_limit.description: Positive strict JSON integer or null. Null removes the cap/limit; omission preserves it on PATCH. Usage limits cannot be reduced below consumed usage.

per_customer_usage_limit.description: Positive strict JSON integer or null. Null removes the cap/limit; omission preserves it on PATCH. Usage limits cannot be reduced below consumed usage.

starts_at.description: ISO 8601 with timezone, seconds and optional six-digit microseconds. Null clears the date. Expiration must be strictly after start, including retained PATCH dates.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 with timezone, seconds and optional six-digit microseconds. Null clears the date. Expiration must be strictly after start, including retained PATCH dates.

is_active.description: Strict JSON boolean; strings and integers are rejected.
